title: Naukri Ke Medical Se Pehle Blood Test — Deoria
description: Bharti ya job ke medical se pehle kaun se blood test khud karwa lein, kis kami ko theek hone me kitna waqt lagta hai, aur Deoria me sample ghar se kaise dein.

takeaways: Bharti ka asli medical bharti board ke apne aspataal me hota hai. Lab se pehle karwaya gaya test uski jagah nahi leta — wo sirf ye batata hai ki aap kis haal me hain.
Hum koi fitness certificate ya medical certificate nahi dete, aur X-ray, ECG, aankh ya sunne ki jaanch bhi hamari service me nahi hai. Hum sirf khoon aur peshab wali jaanch karte hain.
Is ilaake me sabse aam wajah khoon ki kami hoti hai — aur use theek hone me hafton se mahine lagte hain. Isliye jaanch bharti se do-teen mahine pehle matlab rakhti hai, ek hafte pehle nahi.
Report aane ke baad ilaaj doctor se karwaiye. Hum report ka matlab nahi batate aur na hi koi dawa batate hain.

sections.heading: Bharti Ka Medical Aur Lab Test — Do Alag Cheezein Hain
sections.lead: Pehle ye seema saaf kar lijiye, warna paisa aur waqt dono bekaar jaate hain.
blocks: Deoria aur aas-paas ke jile me har saal hazaron ladke-ladkiyan kisi na kisi bharti ki taiyaari me lage rehte hain — sena, police, railway, aur private naukri bhi. In sab me ek medical hota hai, aur usi ko le kar sabse zyada gadbad faili hui hai.

Baat seedhi hai. Bharti ka medical us bharti board ke apne aspataal me, unke apne doctor karte hain, aur fit ya unfit ka faisla wahi karte hain. Bahar se karwaya gaya koi bhi test us faisle ki jagah nahi leta. Kisi bhi lab ka koi kaagaz aapko medical me paas nahi karwa sakta, aur jo aisa kehta ho use nahi sunna chahiye.

To phir pehle se test karwane ka fayda kya hai? Sirf ek, lekin bada: aapko waqt rehte pata chal jaata hai ki sharir me koi aisi kami to nahi jo theek ho sakti hai. Khoon ki kami jaisi cheez hafton me sudhar sakti hai — lekin tabhi jab aapko uska pata hafton pehle chale, medical ke din nahi.

note.title: Hum kya nahi karte
note.text: Hum koi medical fitness certificate ya "fit" ka kaagaz nahi dete — ye kaam doctor ka hai, lab ka nahi. X-ray, ECG, aankh, sunne ki jaanch, lambaai-wazan ka naap — in me se kuch bhi hamari service me shaamil nahi hai. Hum sirf khoon aur peshab wali jaanch karte hain, aur uski report aapko PDF me dete hain.

sections.heading: Pehle Se Jaanch Karwane Ka Asli Fayda — Waqt
sections.lead: Jo cheez theek ho sakti hai, use theek hone ka mauka milna chahiye.
blocks: Medical ke din patta chalne aur teen mahine pehle patta chalne me zameen-aasman ka farak hai. Kuch cheezein sharir me chup-chaap chalti rehti hain aur unka koi lakshan nahi hota — khoon ki kami, sugar, thyroid, ya liver ka koi number. Ye jab bharti ke din saamne aati hain to karne ko kuch nahi bachta. Wahi cheez teen mahine pehle saamne aaye to doctor uska ilaaj shuru kar sakta hai.

Ye baat khaas kar is ilaake me maayne rakhti hai. Khaan-paan ki wajah se yahan khoon ki kami aur vitamin B12 ki kami aam hai, aur dono me sudhaar dhire-dhire aata hai — goli shuru karne ke turant baad nahi.

list: Bharti ki taiyaari shuru karte waqt ek baar jaanch — yahi sabse sahi samay hai.
Report doctor ko dikhaiye. Kami nikli to ilaaj shuru hoga, aur usme lagne wala waqt doctor batayega.
Ilaaj ke baad dobara jaanch — taaki pata chale sudhaar aaya ya nahi. Dobara jaanch usi lab se karaiye jahan pehli hui thi.
Bharti ki tareekh paas ho to naye test se zyada kaam apni purani report le jaana aata hai — doctor silsila dekhte hain.

sections.heading: Naukri Ke Medical Me Aam Taur Par Kaun Si Jaanch Hoti Hai
sections.lead: Har bharti ki apni list hoti hai — ye us list ke aam hisse hain.
blocks: Har vibhag aur har company ki apni list hoti hai, aur wo list unke apne notification me likhi hoti hai. Isliye sabse pehla kaam yahi hai ki apni bharti ka notification khud padh lijiye — us kaagaz se bada koi source nahi hai. Neeche wo jaanch hain jo in liston me aam taur par milti hain, aur ye ki unme se kaun si sample par hoti hai.

sections.heading: Khoon Ki Kami — Is Ilaake Ki Sabse Aam Aur Sabse Sudhaarne Layak Cheez
sections.lead: Aur wo cheez jise sudharne me sabse zyada waqt lagta hai.
blocks: Jab bharti ki taiyaari karne walon ki jaanch hoti hai, to sabse zyada jo cheez nikalti hai wo haemoglobin ka kam hona hai — khaas kar ladkiyon me. Iska koi saaf lakshan nahi hota; thakan aur jaldi saans phoolna aksar mehnat ka nateeja maan liya jaata hai.

Yahan ek galti bahut aam hai. Haemoglobin kam aaya, aur log khud hi iron ki goli shuru kar dete hain. Kam haemoglobin ki wajah hamesha iron ki kami nahi hoti — ferritin aur vitamin B12 bhi dekhe jaate hain, aur is ilaake me B12 ki kami aam hai kyunki khaan-paan zyadatar shaakahaari hai. Wajah galat samjhi gayi to goli chalti rehti hai aur number wahin ka wahin rehta hai.

Doosri baat waqt ki hai. Sahi ilaaj shuru hone ke baad bhi haemoglobin ko upar aane me hafte lagte hain, kabhi mahine. Isliye bharti se ek hafta pehle ki gayi jaanch kisi kaam ki nahi — us waqt sirf pata chalta hai, badla kuch nahi ja sakta.
Haemoglobin, ferritin aur B12 ka poora hisaab — kis me kya dekha jaata hai aur dobara jaanch kab —

sections.heading: Peeliya, Hepatitis Aur Sugar — Jo Bina Awaaz Ke Chalte Hain
sections.lead: Inka pata der se chalne ka nuksan bharti se kahin bada hai.
blocks: Medical ki list me liver ke test aur hepatitis ki jaanch aam hai, aur iski wajah sirf naukri nahi hai. Hepatitis B aur C saalon tak bina kisi lakshan ke chalte rehte hain, aur un par aaj ilaaj maujood hai — Hepatitis C ka to goliyon se. Is jaanch ka fayda naukri se bahut zyada hai.

Yahi baat sugar par laagu hoti hai. Kam umar me sugar nikalna ab is ilaake me aam hai, aur shuruaat me uska koi lakshan nahi hota. Bharti ke medical me ye saamne aa jaaye to sirf bharti ka nuksan hota hai; pehle pata chal jaaye to ilaaj ka poora waqt milta hai.

note.title: Report sirf aapki hai
note.text: HIV, HBsAg aur HCV jaisi report sirf us insaan ko di jaati hai jiska test hua hai, us number par jo booking me diya gaya tha. Test karane ka matlab kisi ko batana nahi hota. Is tarah ki report aane par sabse pehla kaam doctor ko dikhana hai — internet par matlab dhoondhna nahi.

sections.heading: Deoria Me Ye Jaanch Ghar Se Kaise Karayein
sections.lead: Taiyaari chhodni nahi padti — sample ghar par ho jaata hai.
blocks: Bharti ki taiyaari karne walon ka din subah daud se shuru hota hai, aur usi waqt lab bhi khulte hain. Yahi wajah hai ki jaanch tal jaati hai. Ghar se sample dene par ye tikraav khatam ho jaata hai — home visit ke slot subah 6 baje se shuru hote hain, yaani daud se pehle ya turant baad ka waqt liya ja sakta hai.

list: Booking form me naam, mobile number, mohalla ya gaon aur ek landmark bhariye. Lagbhag 30 minute me confirmation call aa jaati hai.
Fasting chahiye ya nahi, ye usi call par bata diya jaata hai. Sugar aur lipid wale test khaali pet hote hain, CBC aur thyroid nahi.
Sample dene se pehle raat ko bhaari mehnat ya gym se bachiye, aur paani peete rahiye — poora khaali pet rehna sirf fasting wale test me chahiye, paani se parhez kabhi nahi.
Trained phlebotomist ID card ke saath aata hai aur sample aapke saamne liya jaata hai. Payment usi waqt, cash ya UPI se — home collection ₹100 hai (poori booking ke liye ek baar).
Report 24 ghante ke andar WhatsApp aur email par PDF me aati hai. Use sambhaal kar rakhiye — aage dobara jaanch me yahi kaam aayegi.

blocks: Ghar me ek se zyada log taiyaari kar rahe hain to sabki booking ek hi slot me kar dijiye — ek hi visit me sabka sample ho jaata hai.
Visit ke din pandrah minute me kya hota hai, aur sample dete waqt chakkar aa jaaye to kya kiya jaata hai —
me likha hai. Koi supplement ya protein powder le rahe hain to wo booking ke waqt bata dijiye —
me iska hisaab hai.

faqs.question: Kya aap job ke liye medical fitness certificate dete hain?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Fitness ya medical certificate dena doctor ka kaam hai, lab ka nahi — hum koi certificate nahi dete. Hum khoon aur peshab wali jaanch karte hain aur uski report PDF me dete hain. Us report ko le kar aap doctor ke paas jaa sakte hain. Bharti ka asli medical us bharti board ke apne aspataal me hota hai aur fit ya unfit ka faisla wahi karte hain.

faqs.question: Bharti ke medical me X-ray aur ECG hota hai — kya wo bhi ghar par ho jaayega?
faqs.answer: Nahi. X-ray, ECG, Echo aur ultrasound machine par hoti hain, ghar par nahi ho sakti, aur wo hamari service me shaamil bhi nahi hai. Aankh, kaan, lambaai aur wazan ki jaanch bhi lab ka kaam nahi hai. Ghar se sirf khoon aur peshab wali jaanch hoti hai — CBC, sugar, LFT, KFT, hepatitis, urine routine aur aise hi test.

faqs.question: Bharti ki tareekh do hafte baad hai — ab test karwane ka fayda hai?
faqs.answer: Pata chal jaayega, lekin badla bahut kam ja sakega. Khoon ki kami jaisi cheez sudharne me hafte se mahine lagte hain, isliye asli fayda tab hai jab jaanch taiyaari ke shuru me karayi jaaye. Do hafte bache hon to sabse kaam ki cheez ye hai ki agar aapki purani report hai to wo doctor ko dikha lijiye, aur naye test ke bharose koi dawa apne aap shuru mat kijiye.

faqs.question: Haemoglobin kam aaya hai — iron ki goli shuru kar dun?
faqs.answer: Apne aap nahi. Kam haemoglobin ki wajah hamesha iron ki kami nahi hoti — ferritin aur vitamin B12 bhi dekhe jaate hain, aur is ilaake me B12 ki kami aam hai. Wajah galat samjhi gayi to goli chalti rehti hai aur number nahi badalta. Report doctor ko dikhaiye; kaun si dawa, kitni aur kitne din — ye wahi tay karenge. Hum na report ka matlab batate hain, na koi dawa.

faqs.question: Medical se pehle ka test kaun se lab se karaana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Jis bhi lab se karayein, ek baat sabse zyada maayne rakhti hai — dobara jaanch usi lab se karaiye. Har lab ka analyser aur method apna hota hai aur reference range bhi usi hisaab se hoti hai, isliye do jagah ke number seedhe milana galat tasveer deta hai. Aur report par ye dekh lijiye ki test ka method likha hai ya nahi aur reference range usi report par chhapi hai ya nahi.

faqs.question: Test se ek din pehle gym ya daud se parhez karna chahiye?
faqs.answer: Sample se pehle wali raat bhaari mehnat se bachna behtar hai, kyunki kuch number us par asar dikhate hain. Paani peete rahiye — fasting me bhi saada paani mana nahi hota. Protein powder ya koi supplement le rahe hain to wo booking ke waqt aur doctor ko zaroor bata dijiye; log ise dawa nahi maante, isliye ye sabse zyada chhoot jaata hai.

faqs.question: Ghar me tin bhai-behen taiyaari kar rahe hain — sabka test ek saath ho jaayega?
faqs.answer: Haan, aur yahi sabse aasan tareeka hai. Sabki booking ek hi slot me kar dijiye, ek hi visit me sabka sample ho jaata hai. Booking ke waqt har ek ka naam, umar aur uske test alag-alag likhwa dijiye taaki report me koi uljhan na ho. Report sabki alag PDF me aati hai.
